welle_m1.abspaltung.titel: {name} is gathering loyalists for a party of their own
welle_m1.abspaltung.text1: Since being sidelined, {name} has been meeting deputies and local branches. The founding application is announced for {datum, date}, in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
welle_m1.abspaltung.text2: Expected: {anteil, prozent, 1} of the vote from your camp, plus {n, plural, =0 {no deputy} one {# deputy} other {# deputies}} of your {eigene}-seat parliamentary group.
welle_m1.abspaltung.text_vorbei: The matter of {name} has been settled.
welle_m1.abspaltung.warum: A crown prince who is broken but stays ambitious founds a party of their own. Its size depends on their standing in the party.
welle_m1.abspaltung.versoehnen.label: Reconcile
welle_m1.abspaltung.versoehnen.beschr: {name} gets a post and an agreement for one year. The party stays united, but the succession question returns.
welle_m1.abspaltung.versoehnen.zahlen: Succession pressure {vorher} → {nachher}, loyalty {loy}, no new party
welle_m1.abspaltung.versoehnen.aus: {name} returns to the party. The founding is called off.
welle_m1.abspaltung.beschleunigen.label: Speed up the expulsion
welle_m1.abspaltung.beschleunigen.beschr: The party opens expulsion proceedings. The new party forms at once but has less time to gather support.
welle_m1.abspaltung.beschleunigen.zahlen: Fear in the apparatus {angst}, succession pressure {druck}
welle_m1.abspaltung.beschleunigen.aus: {name} is expelled and founds a party at once: {anteil, prozent, 1} of the vote, {n, plural, =0 {no deputy} one {# deputy} other {# deputies}}.
welle_m1.abspaltung.gewaehren.label: Let it happen
welle_m1.abspaltung.gewaehren.beschr: No intervention. The founding comes on {datum, date}.
welle_m1.abspaltung.zahlen: New party: {anteil, prozent, 1} of the vote, {n, plural, =0 {no deputy} one {# deputy} other {# deputies}} defecting
welle_m1.abspaltung.gruendung.titel: {name} founds a party of their own
welle_m1.abspaltung.gruendung.fakt: The {partei} has been founded. It takes {anteil, prozent, 1} of the vote from your camp; {n, plural, =0 {no deputy} one {# deputy} other {# deputies}} join it.
welle_m1.abspaltung.log.bruch_warum: Sidelined, ambitious and barely loyal. A party of their own is expected in {tage} days.
welle_m1.saeuberung.titel: After the coup attempt: how far should the reckoning go?
welle_m1.saeuberung.text1: The coup has failed. Fear grips the apparatus ({angst} of 100), and the lists of suspects grow longer.
welle_m1.saeuberung.text2: A broad purge protects against the next attempt but costs competence, press freedom and the road to Europe.
welle_m1.saeuberung.warum: A purge is only possible with cause: after an uncovered coup circle or a coup attempt.
welle_m1.saeuberung.saeubern.label: Purge the apparatus
welle_m1.saeuberung.saeubern.beschr: Dismissals by decree in the army, police, judiciary and civil service.
welle_m1.saeuberung.saeubern.zahlen: Coup protection {monate} months, fear {angst}, competence in the apparatus {kompetenz}, EU {eu}, press freedom {presse}
welle_m1.saeuberung.saeubern.eu_friert: The EU freezes the accession talks.
welle_m1.saeuberung.saeubern.eu_schon: The accession talks are already frozen.
welle_m1.saeuberung.saeubern.aus: The purge is under way. Thousands lose their posts.
welle_m1.saeuberung.gericht.label: Put only the plotters on trial
welle_m1.saeuberung.gericht.beschr: Charges against those involved; the apparatus stays in place.
welle_m1.saeuberung.abwarten.label: Let the courts do their work
welle_m1.saeuberung.abwarten.aus: The courts are at work. Unrest lingers in the officer corps.
welle_m1.kreis.frage: Who could take power from you?
welle_m1.kreis.stil: Style of rule: {stil} ({grad} of 100). Fear in the apparatus: {angst}.
welle_m1.kreis.parteitag: Party congress in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · challenge from {kampf}
welle_m1.kreis.parteitag.ausser: Extraordinary congress in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · challenge from {kampf}
welle_m1.kreis.gefahr_keine: No one is reaching for your office right now.
welle_m1.kreis.netz_zeile: Network, secrets and levers for press, Constitutional Court, central bank and opposition
welle_m1.kreis.minister_hinweis: Recognition, backing and dismissal of a minister are in the cabinet: talk and dismissal.
welle_m1.kreis.grund.kapazitaet: The service has only {kap} capacity free; {noetig} is needed.
welle_m1.kreis.zahlen.untersuchung: Ties up {kap} of the service (free {frei}); the result comes as a case
welle_m1.kreis.zahlen.kp_kalt_bruch: Break looms: own party in {monate} months, {anteil, prozent, 1}, {n, plural, =0 {no deputy} one {# deputy} other {# deputies}}.
welle_m1.kreis.zahlen.fc_kalt: Discipline {vorher} → {nachher} votes per bill, one year
welle_m1.kreis.zahlen.gespraech: In the cabinet: recognition, resources or backing
welle_m1.kreis.zahlen.entlassen: In the cabinet: choose a successor
welle_m1.kreis.abspaltung.droht_text: {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left. Reconcile or speed up the expulsion: via the case on your desk.
welle_m1.gefahr.parteitag: {name} will challenge you at the congress (in {tage} days)

welle_m1.dienst.satz: The service acts on your instructions and reports when the situation offers an opportunity.
welle_m1.dienst.frage: What can the service do that diplomacy and the army cannot?
welle_m1.dienst.naechste: Next opportunity in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} at the earliest
welle_m1.dienst.naechste_frei: An opportunity can come at any time
welle_m1.dienst.zweck.zugriff: Bring back a wanted person from abroad. Usually works only with the host country's help; if exposed, relations suffer.
welle_m1.dienst.zweck.kader: Take out PKK or IS leaders in Syria or Iraq. Lowers the terror threat and can set back a peace process.
welle_m1.dienst.zweck.kanal: Host a prisoner exchange between Washington and Moscow in Ankara. Earns standing with both.
welle_m1.dienst.aussicht.zugriff: Chance {von} to {bis}%, depending on the host country's cooperation
welle_m1.dienst.bed.kader: PKK {pkk}, IS {is}: the opportunity comes from {ab}
welle_m1.dienst.bed.kanal: Trust USA {usa}, Russia {rus}: comes when both reach at least {ab}
welle_m1.dienst.bed.zugriff: Comes with {chance}% a month once an opportunity is free

welle_m1.dienst.laufend: {land}, {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} left
welle_m1.dienst.laeuft: Runs for {monate, plural, one {# more month} other {# more months}}
welle_m1.dienst.gegen.text: Makes foreign operations against Turkey rarer and their discovery more likely. Uncovered so far: {fremd}.
welle_m1.dienst.ausbau: Expanding the service: staff {personal}, technology {technik}, reach {reichweite}
welle_m1.dienst.laufend_zeile: against {land}, {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} left
